title: Linear Equation Solver
objective: Solve and evaluate small systems of linear equations with numerical checks.

starter_files.purpose: Functions for loading, validating, transforming, and summarizing arrays.
Small synthetic input data; document schema, units, and missing-value rules.
Automated tests for normal, boundary, and invalid inputs.
Setup, run instructions, assumptions, expected output, and reproducibility notes.

required_features: Accept a coefficient matrix and right-hand-side vector.
Validate shapes and solve with numpy.linalg.
Calculate residuals and use allclose with a justified tolerance.
Report rank or conditioning caveats where relevant.
stretch_features: Process larger inputs in bounded chunks or through a memory map where it helps.
Add a reproducible benchmark or a second numerical method and document the trade-off.
Produce a simple labeled plot using an optional compatible visualization library.

tests.name: Numerical correctness
steps: Run the solution against known synthetic values.
Use exact comparisons only when exactness is expected; otherwise justify tolerance values.

tests.name: Boundary and validation
steps: Try empty, malformed, wrong-shape, wrong-dtype, and non-finite inputs as relevant.
Confirm failure messages are clear and no invalid success result is reported.

tests.name: Reproducibility and documentation
steps: Run from a clean environment with documented dependencies.
Verify the README expected outputs and record software versions.

rubric.criterion: Array reasoning: shape, dtype, and numerical assumptions

review_method: Automated local tests plus human rubric review. Project submission and grading are not configured to execute arbitrary Python in the production API.
status_note: Draft brief derived from the supplied PDF. Starter implementation, test data, and human-review rubric require review before publication.
